name: symphony-ingress
description: Jetson-facing streaming ingress and device/user authorizer for the Symphony tenant agent.

scripts.build: esbuild src/ingress.mjs src/authorizer.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
